`_run_style_path` stages work in this order:

1. If the path ends in `.slang` or `.inc`, it immediately delegates to Slang formatting and stops ([fix/__init__.py:205-208](/tmp/codegraph-codex-eval/control/t-new-1/fix/__init__.py:205)).
2. It discovers Odin files. An empty result (`[]`) falls back to Slang formatting; `None` does not—it later falls back to formatting the original path with odinfmt ([fix/__init__.py:209-212](/tmp/codegraph-codex-eval/control/t-new-1/fix/__init__.py:209)).
3. Runs `fix_var_decl_style`; any nonzero result returns immediately ([fix/__init__.py:214-217](/tmp/codegraph-codex-eval/control/t-new-1/fix/__init__.py:214)).
4. Runs `normalize_imports`; any nonzero result also returns immediately ([fix/__init__.py:219-222](/tmp/codegraph-codex-eval/control/t-new-1/fix/__init__.py:219)).
5. Resolves odinfmt, disabling bootstrap and updates during dry runs. If discovery returned `None`, it uses `[path]` as the odinfmt input ([fix/__init__.py:224-227](/tmp/codegraph-codex-eval/control/t-new-1/fix/__init__.py:224)).
6. Runs odinfmt, returning immediately on failure, then formats the path as Slang ([fix/__init__.py:227-230](/tmp/codegraph-codex-eval/control/t-new-1/fix/__init__.py:227)).

`_run_odinfmt_paths` first previews every command. It returns success without execution when dry-run is enabled or the path list is empty ([fix/__init__.py:49-53](/tmp/codegraph-codex-eval/control/t-new-1/fix/__init__.py:49)). Otherwise it runs paths concurrently and returns the first nonzero result, or `0` if all succeed ([fix/__init__.py:55-58](/tmp/codegraph-codex-eval/control/t-new-1/fix/__init__.py:55)). A missing formatter process result counts as failure (`1`); otherwise the subprocess return code propagates ([fix/__init__.py:42-46](/tmp/codegraph-codex-eval/control/t-new-1/fix/__init__.py:42).
